name: Default
shortDescription: Single-node VictoriaMetrics time series database with Prometheus-compatible ingestion and querying, the vmui web interface and persistent storage.

alerts.message: Every endpoint except the health checks, including vmui and the write API, requires HTTP basic auth with VM_AUTH_USERNAME and VM_AUTH_PASSWORD from the environment. Configure the same credentials in Prometheus remote_write, vmagent or Grafana.
